messages.subject: lavaan WARNING: could not compute standard errors
parts:
Hi, I'm learning how to do a latent change score model using the lavaan package. I have N=141 and the following is the correlation matrix.
                RT1             RT2             RT3                 DET3
RT1         1.00           
RT2         0.50             1.00             
RT3         0.37             0.63             1.00                
DET3      -0.38            -0.57            -0.53                 1.00

I created a latent change score 1 based on RT1(Time1) and RT2(Time2) and another latent change score 2 based on RT2(Time2) and RT3(Time3). My hypothetical model is that RT1, RT2, and the two change factors will have an influence on DET3, a variable measured at time 3. I got an error captioned in this post when I tried to regress DeT3 ~ RT1 + RT2 + dRT1 + dRT2. However, it was fine when I put  DeT3 ~ RT1 + RT2 or DeT3 ~ RT1 + dRT1 + dRT2. I guess there may be conflict in my parameter settings but I can't figure it out. I hope someone can give some insights to this issue. 

Following is my complete codes.

Model<-'
RT2 ~ 1*RT1    # Fixed regression of T2 on T1
RT3 ~ 1*RT2    # Fixed regression of T3 on T2

dRT1 =~ 1*T2     # Fixed regression of latent change score dRT1 on T2
dRT2 =~ 1*T3     # Fixed regression of latent chagne score dRT2 on T3

RT2 ~ 0*1         # Fixed intercept at 0
RT3 ~ 0*1        # Fixed intercept at 0

RT2 ~~ 0*RT2    # This fixes the variance of the T2 to 0 
RT3 ~~ 0*RT3    # This fixes the variance of the T3 to 0 

dRT1 ~ 1             # This estimates the intercept of the change scores 
dRT2 ~ 1             # This estimates the intercept of the change scores
RT1 ~ 1               # This estimates the intercept of T1

dRT1 ~~ dRT1       # This estimates the variance of the change scores dRT1
dRT2 ~~ dRT2       # This estimates the variance of the change scores dRT2
RT1 ~~  RT1           # This estimates the variance of T1

dRT1 ~ RT1         # This estimates the self-feedback parameter
dRT2 ~ RT2         # This estimates the self-feedback parameter

#dependent variable
DeT3 ~~ DeT3
DeT3 ~ 1
DeT3 ~ RT1 + RT2 + dRT1 + dRT2 ( This code gives me an error. However, it works fine when my the other models just have DeT3 ~ RT1 + RT2 or DeT3 ~ RT1 + dRT1 + dRT2)
'
fit <- lavaan(Model, data=Data1, estimator='mlr',fixed.x=FALSE)
summary(fit, standardized = TRUE,fit.measures=TRUE)
